search_strategies.source: Fixed historical and modern Cochrane sources
search_strategies.platform: Cochrane reference dataset and published review packages
search_strategies.query: Retrieve CL145_open_set_20181101.zip from https://zenodo.org/records/1303259 (SHA-256 f921cf6f1a9236c86f89e7c646497639f45e8ff8fcf56008c1b27422829fec4f), and the already-held published packages for CD014911 and CD015089. Parse available study-level 2x2 tables with scripts/cochrane_dta_atlas.py at the pinned commit. This is fixed-corpus acquisition, not a new exhaustive Cochrane search.
search_strategies.limits: 63 historical reviews and two selected modern reviews. The count and checksum identify the normalized corpus manifest. Acquisition and analysis are documented by 16 August 2026; the first download date of already-held packages is not recorded.

search_strategies.platform: NCBI E-Utilities and PMC JATS XML
search_strategies.query: (("diagnostic test accuracy"[Title/Abstract]) OR ("diagnostic accuracy"[Title/Abstract])) AND ("2x2"[All Fields] OR "2 x 2"[All Fields] OR ("true positive"[All Fields] AND "false positive"[All Fields] AND "false negative"[All Fields] AND "true negative"[All Fields])) AND (systematic review[Title/Abstract] OR meta-analysis[Title/Abstract]) AND open access[filter] AND 2020:2026[Publication Date] NOT protocol[Title]
search_strategies.limits: The fixed query returned 1,518 articles on 2026-08-17; all were retrieved. Only explicit identifiers and integer TP, FP, FN, TN columns were normalized. Count and checksum identify articles.csv.

date_limits.justification: No common date window: historical Cochrane is a fixed 2018 release; PMC uses 2020-2026 publication years; other sources use recorded inventories or queries. Source-specific limits govern inclusion.

timing_explanation: The study was registered internally with ConductScience on 16 August 2026. The public protocol record and its DOI were established on 13 September 2026. The protocol has a versioned amendment history: source-priority rules developed during staged audits were fixed before the final reference analysis. This version documents the completed methods and distinguishes the original internal registration from subsequent amendments and public posting.
